title: What do you thinknof using AI?
author: PhillipPilgrim
selftext:
Personally, I don’t mind using AI, but I’m hesitant to use it for everything, from artwork and marketing to music. I think it’s hard for AI to replace the human touch that makes those things special. (Yes, I’ve tried it. Maybe I’m just bad at it.)

Where AI helps me the most is with coding. A lot of things would take me months on my own, and that’s before even getting into building a prototype. With AI, I can get things done in days, though I still have to review the code and keep playtesting the game.

What do you all think? I would like to know your point of view. 

And the video i put to show when AI helps only with code and smoothing some levels of details in light and enviroment (And FPS fixing)

comments.author: ChirpXel
comments.body:
Need a dedicated light for your character, scene looks nice. but badly optimized. My assumption is you aked for a Ghibli color/art style. Looks good, but remember a game is more than a walking simulator. 

Keep up the good work

replies.author: PhillipPilgrim
replies.body:
That's a great idea this light! I will definetely try that.

Actually... I didn't asked this was made purely by me this lightning :) I was trying to hurt prototype as much possible it is to see how much Unity can handle. And this was just a quick script and also using of Open Source light systems :o But thanks for great advice!! <3

comments.author: Intelligent-Basil293
comments.body: It looks very cute, but the framerate is hurting my eyes!!

replies.author: PhillipPilgrim
replies.body: Framerate was fixed. It was because of distanceDraw set too high. Also grass was needed to be lower of density by 45% and just making it little bigger and it's now on 140-170.

comments.author: PhillipPilgrim
comments.body:
P.S. The video is just a quick prototype I threw together to see how much the engine could handle xD. I posted this because I’m curious how you all feel about using AI in game development. If you use AI for everything or anything i mentioned (like graphic or music), that’s totally fine. I’m just sharing where I personally find it most helpful and want to know your opinion ❤️
